slides.title: Third and mixed conditionals
slides.subtitle: Imagining a different past and present
goals: Use the third conditional for past regrets.
Mix past condition + present result, and vice versa.

head: Type
Form
Example
rows: If + had done, would have done
If I had left earlier, I wouldn't have missed the flight.
If I had studied medicine, I **would be** a doctor now.
If I **were** more organized, I **would have finished** on time.

items.q: If I had saved money, I ___ a car now.
If she weren't so shy, she ___ to the party last night.
If we had taken the map, we ___ lost.

items.t: If I ___ (not / break) my leg, I would be playing today.
If he spoke English, he ___ (get) the job last year.
